services.heading: Everything your brand needs to win

methodology.heading: AI speed. Human judgment.
methodology.subheading: Tools alone don't grow brands, and gut feel doesn't scale. WABEL runs on both — deliberately.

ai.title: What AI does
points: Analyzes thousands of data points to find what's working — and kills what isn't, fast
Generates and tests dozens of ad variants while competitors are still in a meeting
Predicts spend, demand, and seasonality so budgets land where they pay off
Reports in real time — no waiting until month-end to learn you overspent

human.title: What people do
points: Translate culture, dialect, and timing the way only Saudis can
Set the strategy and the story the machine optimizes toward
Protect the brand so growth never comes at the cost of taste
Stay accountable — a named team you can call, not a ticket queue

process.heading: How we work
process.subheading: A clear five-step loop. You always know what's happening and why.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We learn your market, margins, and goals — then audit everything you're running today.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.description: A data-backed plan with clear KPIs, channels, and a budget tied to outcomes, not vanity metrics.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Campaigns, creative, and systems go live — built fast, launched clean, instrumented to learn.

steps.title: Measurement
steps.description: Live dashboards show exactly what each riyal returns. No black boxes, no surprises.

steps.title: Optimization
steps.description: We double down on winners, cut the rest, and compound results month over month.

pricing.heading: Plans that scale with you
pricing.subheading: Monthly retainers, no long lock-ins. Start where you are; pour on more when you're ready.
